profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Bloomberg LP
profile.summary: Through years of professional and personal development, I have tackled a ranged of engineering challenges. I have architected search engines and developed extensible UI frameworks. I have mentored engineers through transitions to modern stacks. I look to lead in making significant impact, achieving scale, and optimizing user experience.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Improved project development process ensuring results are reproducible, and attainable in 50-75% of the budget previously required.

Pioneered a foundation of reusable codebases comprising of a web engine, a search engine, a React UI framework, and CI workflows critical to the repeatable delivery of large scale website projects.

Showcased the legal expertise of law firms by revamping their web presence delivering RubensteinTech's proprietary content hub/CMS, search engines, internationalization, and enhanced user experience.

Increased impact of team members by leading engineers through company-wide transition to a modern MERN-like stack (Couchbase, Express, React, Node).

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Overhauled the group's core RubyLaw content hub offering that powers law firm websites by transitioning to a modern tech stack.

Shipped key product features in addition to overhaul boosting our CMS users to be twice as efficient and effective.

Architected fully customizable search engines allowing clients to dictate finer business logic requirements and search criteria.

positions.title: Engineering Temporary Aide
positions.description: Led digital transformation of a data/assets management group during two internships.

honors.title: IEEE Student Design Contest First Place
honors.description: Developed a long distance eye gaze tracker geared towards gathering data from multiple individuals with Christopher Hong and William Ho.  Potential applications included advertising, media, and education.  Earned first place in the 2013 IEEE Student Design Contest.

honors.title: Cooper Union Full Tuition Scholarship
honors.issuer: Issued by The Cooper Union · Sep 2009

volunteerExperiences.description: Mentored a high school student while he navigated the final two years leading into college.
Taught a class of first time computer science students in high school AP class with a first time computer science teacher at Pan American International High School in Queens, NY .
